name: Builder
description: A pack for making things with Claude: your own plugins, and projects planned as tasks and concepts.
author: layr

sessions.name: Make a plugin
sessions.description: Claude, with a first message ready, makes a small plugin; its page in layr (About this plugin) shows its history and versions.

params.prompt: Make me a small layr plugin: a daily checklist panel whose items are kept in the plugin's own data, with a box to add an item and a tick to check one off. Keep it simple, then tell me how to open it.

sessions.name: Plan a project
sessions.description: The pipeline's task board next to the concept map: plan the ideas, then run them as Claude tasks.
